description: One question that two or more question entries ask. A question that is in no topic is its own topic. One answer to the topic answers each of its questions.

question.description: The question, in one sentence, for the product owner.

label.description: The topic in one to three words, for example Rounding.

members.description: The full IDs of the question entries that ask it, for example a1/Q2.

examples.question: Which step rounds the discount, and to how many decimals?
examples.label: Rounding
